provenance.derivation: Editorial selection, not a generated harmony. Seven of the twenty-four Quiet Neutrals chosen by hand for lightness spacing across the group: one deep anchor, two lights, three mid neutrals and one warm accent.
provenance.editorialNotes: The anchor is 底墨 rather than a mid grey. In a neutral palette the deep value is what every other member is judged against, and a palette anchored in the middle leaves its lights sitting on nothing. 枯藁 is the only member above the group’s warm centre and is the accent for exactly that reason — it is the palette’s one colour decision. Roles are editorial; no generator was involved, and FR-22 requires that to be true rather than assumed.
